name: darkest_inifuss_entry
comment: Tree of Inifuss entry: one crypt room with stairs up (cryptewarpprev) and the waypoint. The stairs come out at the cave mouth next to the tree; that starts the waves. (Cave stairs crashed the game when linked to a hand-made outdoor map; crypt stairs work, as in the Burial Grounds.)

extra_objects.comment: WaypointOutsideAct1 (objpreset Act 1 Index 52). Its HD look is the prefab below, placed as in the game's act1/outdoors/waypoint map (object at sub-tile 14,14 -> prefab at 37,38).
